act_title: The Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006
title: Penalty for food containing extraneous matter
text:
54. Penalty for food containing extraneous matter.—Any person whether by himself or by any

other person on his behalf manufactures for sale or stores or sells or distributes or imports any article of
food for human consumption containing extraneous matter, shall be liable to a penalty which may extend
to one lakh rupees.
